content.text:
The report lists failures: (1) product of two long-history standardized measures (flow and stock) had no predictive power; (2) cross-sectional rank product of pay growth and hours change gave zero IC and was redundant; (3) an invalid submission exceeded the word limit.

The proposed expression is a spread (difference) between two standardized yoy series, which is not a product, and it is not a rank product. It resembles the tentative finding (a spread between two flow rates, each standardized against its own history). The hypothesis is about 30 words, which is probably under the limit, though the limit is not stated. The spread avoids the product form and the rank-product form. It does use pay growth and hours, similar to the failed rank product's inputs, but with a different construction (time-series standardization spread).

The hypothesis avoids the failures explicitly in structure, but the word limit is unknown. The hypothesis also predicts a positive sign, whereas the tentative finding had a sign opposite to the predicted one, which is not itself a failure listed. Overall, it likely avoids the failures.

{"avoids_failure": true}
